note: Template library, source of truth. Node, the CLI and the test suite read this file directly. The browser opens over file:// and cannot fetch .json, so run `node build-templates.js` to regenerate glyph-data.js after editing. The [ph-name] holes in a body are the parameters: a call binds them by name ([ph-name'value']) or by position (bare literals, in declaration order). An unbound hole becomes <needs> and does not block. The same [ph-name] may appear more than once in a body; every occurrence receives the same value. A param may instead be marked "repeat": true (at most one per template) for a variadic hole: it is excluded from positional order (a fixed param declared after it would collide with however many repeats were supplied) and binds only through the call repeating [ph-name'v1'][ph-name'v2']..., each occurrence becoming one more sibling node where the hole sat. Zero repeats drops the hole from the output instead of leaving a <needs> — it is optional plurality on top of whatever fixed params already satisfy the template's minimum, not a required slot. See best-of's `more` param.

germinate.gloss: Walks every aspect of a situation as seeds and lays the path to the goal as a tree: roots=problem, trunk=effort, branches=resources, leaves=actions, fruit=goal.

params.name: alvo
params.ask: what to germinate — the situation, subject or problem

params.name: criterio
params.ask: what to validate the result against

germinate.body: [itr[ph-alvo`over seeds (every aspect of a situation, being it good, bad or neutral)`][val[lrn[impr`basic thinking`[skl`tree logic structure`[tgt`roots=problem,trunk=effort (anything that takes time and demands action),branches=resources(place, idea, person, method, any kind of),leaves = actions(effective denoted actions to be made to achieve the goal along the branch),fruit = the goal.`]]]][ph-criterio`the external criterion to validate against`]]

scientific-review.gloss: Apply scientific rigour: criticise the target, rework it with what the critique found, and validate the result against an external standard.

params.name: target
params.ask: what to put under scientific review

params.name: standard
params.ask: the external standard to hold it to — method, evidence, reproducibility

scientific-review.body: [crit[ph-target`what to put under scientific review`]][rwk`the target itself, corrected by what the critique found`][val`the reworked result`,[ph-standard`the external standard: method, evidence, reproducibility`]]

reinforce.gloss: There is a must-follow rule. Raise its precedence and state why it holds, so it survives a long context.

params.name: rule
params.ask: the rule that must be followed

reinforce.body: [prio[mand[ph-rule`the rule that must be followed`]]][rsn[ph-why`why it must hold, so it is not dropped later`]]

insight.gloss: Frame the situation and its limits first, then brainstorm one realistic way out — not a list of options.

params.name: situation
params.ask: the situation to get out of

insight.body: [ctx[ph-situation`the situation to get out of`]][cnst[ph-limits`what the idea must respect`]][brst`one realistic way out, restricted by the constraints above — not a list of options`][real]

fertilize.gloss: Add base context to a situation, surface the implicit details as seeds, rebuild the problem from them, and propose new resources. Companion to germinate.

params.name: known
params.ask: what is already established and must not be re-derived

fertilize.body: [ctx[ph-situation`the situation to fertilize`]][base[ph-known`what is already established and must not be re-derived`]][elab`seeds — the details the situation left implicit`][drvf`rebuild the roots (the problem) from those seeds`][prop`new resources to feed the branches — at least two, of different kinds: place, idea, person or method`]

best-of.gloss: Compare candidates that share one context, score them against a stated condition, name the winner and return the points that justify it.

params.name: more
params.ask: an extra candidate beyond the first two — repeat the ph-more call once per extra candidate

params.name: criterion
params.ask: the condition that decides the winner

best-of.body: [ctx[ph-context`the context all candidates share`]][cmp[ph-a`first candidate`],[ph-b`second candidate`],[ph-more`an extra candidate, repeated once per extra`]][val`each candidate against the stated condition`,[ph-criterion`the condition that decides the winner`]][cncl`the winner`][rtnl`the points that justify the result`]

track.gloss: Explain where a detail came from across a long context: where it entered, what changed it, where it stands now. For the small things a human lets slip.

params.name: item
params.ask: the detail whose origin to explain

params.name: scope
params.ask: the stretch of conversation to trace through

track.body: [ctx[ph-scope`the stretch of conversation to trace through`]][drvf[ph-item`the detail whose origin to explain`]][elab`the chain: where it entered, what changed it, where it stands now`]
